title: chrysophtalmum montanum
intro: Chrysophtalmum montanum, commonly known as Himalayan gold or Mountain chamomile, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and calming properties that can help alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chrysophtalmum montanum include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
